findings.evidence: False positive: the pattern 'race' matched only as a substring, and no race or ethnicity data exists in these files. CrashHandlerInitializer.kt:20-21 'stackTrace' is a local variable holding an exception stack trace. HistoricalProcessExitReasonsInitializer.kt:29-30 'stackTrace' is the ApplicationExitInfo trace. activity_item_full.xml:74 tools:text="Bracer" is a design-time preview name of a Dota 2 item. A whole-word search for race/ethnicity in all three files returned nothing. Logger Loop heuristic: both initializers pass diagnostic strings to Logger.log (CrashHandlerInitializer.kt:23, HistoricalProcessExitReasonsInitializer.kt:31), and LoggerImpl.kt:21-23 only emits them to an in-memory MutableSharedFlow (replay 100). Its subscribers stay on the device: an in-app log list (DrawerFragment.kt:231), logcat via Log.d (CameraFragment.kt:100-101) and on-screen logs in the XO game (XoViewModel.kt:44-46). The app-logger module has no network dependency, and the Gradle build files and version catalog contain no Firebase, Crashlytics, AppMetrica, Sentry or ad SDK, so no off-device sink was found. Step 2 (disclosure search) does not apply because nothing is transferred.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. Do not declare Race and ethnicity in the Data safety form. If a crash-reporting or analytics SDK is added to the Logger later, re-audit it, because the form currently declares no data collected.
